resources.string: The floor (temperature and dose) is the first point; the dose then follows the points above it in straight lines, never less than the floor dose. Below the floor temperature the floor counts. By feel, the floor temperature is lowered by how far feels-like is below the temperature, and the line continues below the floor dose. The window dose is the average of every minute\'s dose, plus the offset.
Dose points, one per line: °C then mL
Not saved: temperatures must be -15 to 50 °C, doses 0.1 to 3.0 mL, at least two points, and the offset 0.00 to 1.00 mL.
